description: Defines the MockPersistentNelStore class, a mock implementation of NetworkErrorLoggingService::PersistentNelStore for testing purposes, including command handling, policy management, and verification methods.

classes.name: MockPersistentNelStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of PersistentNelStore for testing, simulating policy storage and command execution.

classes.name: MockPersistentNelStore::Command
classes.description: Represents a command issued to the mock store, including types for loading, adding, updating, deleting policies, and flushing.

methods.name: LoadNelPolicies
methods.description: Simulates loading stored policies and executes the provided callback.

methods.name: AddNelPolicy
methods.description: Adds a new NEL policy to the mock store.

methods.name: UpdateNelPolicyAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time for a specified NEL policy.

methods.name: SetPrestoredPolicies
methods.description: Sets pre-existing policies to simulate stored data.

methods.name: FinishLoading
methods.description: Completes the loading process, executing the callback with success or failure.

methods.name: VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies that the received command list matches expected commands.

methods.name: GetAllCommands
methods.description: Returns all commands issued to the store.

methods.name: StoredPoliciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of policies that would be stored.
